successCriteria.description: PgLeaveRequestRepository implements all ILeaveRequestRepository methods (findById, findByEmployeeId, findByStatus, findByManagerId, create, update, updateStatus) using parameterized queries against the `leave_requests` table, with snake_case↔camelCase mapping via a mapRowTo* function
findByManagerId uses a JOIN query: SELECT lr.* FROM leave_requests lr JOIN employees e ON lr.employee_id = e.id WHERE e.manager_id = $1, returning LeaveRequest[]

updateStatus enforces the allowed state transitions: DRAFT→SUBMITTED, SUBMITTED→APPROVED|REJECTED, SUBMITTED|APPROVED→CANCELLED; sets approvedBy/approvedAt when transitioning to 'approved'; sets rejectionReason when transitioning to 'rejected'; rejects invalid transitions

LeaveRequestService.submit validates the DTO via createLeaveRequestSchema, calls policyService.validateEntitlement, calculates days using the binding rule (endDate.getTime() - startDate.getTime()) / (1000*60*60*24) + 1, checks balanceService.hasSufficientBalance, creates the request with status 'submitted', calls notificationService.notifyLeaveSubmitted, and writes an audit log entry

LeaveRequestService.approve verifies the request exists and is in 'submitted' status, updates status to 'approved' with approvedBy/approvedAt, calls balanceService.deductBalance, calls notificationService.notifyLeaveApproved, and writes an audit log entry

LeaveRequestService.reject verifies the request exists and is in 'submitted' status, validates rejectionReason is non-empty, updates status to 'rejected' with rejectionReason, calls notificationService.notifyLeaveRejected, and writes an audit log entry

LeaveRequestService.cancel verifies the request exists, enforces self-cancellation (employeeId must match request.employeeId), verifies current status is 'submitted' or 'approved', updates status to 'cancelled', calls notificationService.notifyLeaveCancelled, and writes an audit log entry
LeaveRequestService.getById, getByEmployee, and getPendingForManager delegate directly to the corresponding repository methods without additional business logic

PgNotificationRepository implements all INotificationRepository methods (findByRecipientId, findByRecipientIdAndStatus, create, updateStatus) using parameterized queries against the `notifications` table, with snake_case↔camelCase mapping

NotificationService.notifyLeaveSubmitted/Approved/Rejected/Cancelled each create a Notification with the correct NotificationType, recipientId=leaveRequest.employeeId, relatedEntityType='leave_request', relatedEntityId=leaveRequest.id, and status='pending'
NotificationService.markAsRead updates the notification status to 'read' and sets readAt to the current timestamp

LeaveRequest controller handlers validate request bodies against the Zod schemas from leave-request.model.ts (createLeaveRequestSchema for submit, updateLeaveRequestSchema for updates) and return standard error responses with the correct error codes (NOT_FOUND, VALIDATION_ERROR, INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE) matching the error contract
Leave-request routes are registered as a Fastify plugin in src/app.ts alongside the existing uptimeRoutes

constraints: All database access must go through repository classes — no inline SQL in services or controllers (GP-001)
Every state-changing operation (submit, approve, reject, cancel) must write an audit log record via IAuditLogRepository (GP-002)
All controller inputs must be validated via Zod schemas before processing (GP-003)
Repository implementations must use parameterized queries ($1, $2, …) — no string interpolation of user-supplied values into SQL

entityInvariants.invariant: A LeaveRequest's status must follow the allowed lifecycle: DRAFT→SUBMITTED, SUBMITTED→APPROVED|REJECTED, SUBMITTED|APPROVED→CANCELLED. REJECTED and CANCELLED are terminal states — no further transitions are permitted.
A Notification is created with status 'pending'. It transitions to 'read' when markAsRead is called (which also sets readAt). The 'sent' and 'archived' statuses are reserved for future phases.

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Caller must be authenticated; the employeeId in the DTO must match the authenticated user's id unless the caller has manager/hr_admin role
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws LeaveRequestValidationError (code: VALIDATION_ERROR) for invalid DTO; throws domain error (code: INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE) when balance check fails; throws domain error when policy validation fails

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Caller must have manager or hr_admin role; the approverId must match the authenticated user's id
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws LeaveRequestNotFoundError (code: NOT_FOUND) if request does not exist; throws domain error if request is not in 'submitted' status

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Caller must have manager or hr_admin role; the approverId must match the authenticated user's id
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws LeaveRequestNotFoundError (code: NOT_FOUND) if request does not exist; throws LeaveRequestValidationError (code: VALIDATION_ERROR) if reason is empty; throws domain error if request is not in 'submitted' status

interfaceConstraints.authRule: Caller must be authenticated; the employeeId must match the authenticated user's id (self-cancellation only)
interfaceConstraints.errorSemantics: Throws LeaveRequestNotFoundError (code: NOT_FOUND) if request does not exist; throws domain error if employeeId does not match request.employeeId; throws domain error if request is not in 'submitted' or 'approved' status

consistencyRequirements.requirement: Repository implementations must follow the same pattern as PgBalanceRepository and PgAuditLogRepository: import `pool` from `../../shared/db/connection`, define a `*Row` interface for snake_case DB rows, implement a `mapRowTo*` function, and use parameterized queries throughout

Service implementations must follow the same pattern as BalanceService: constructor receives repository interfaces via dependency injection, methods delegate to repositories and throw typed domain errors (with `.code` property) for business rule violations

Controller and routes must follow the same pattern as BalanceController and balanceRoutes: controller class with arrow-function handlers, routes file that instantiates dependencies and registers them as a Fastify plugin
The leave-request routes plugin must be registered in src/app.ts via `app.register(leaveRequestRoutes)` alongside the existing `app.register(uptimeRoutes)`, following the same pattern

integrationPoints.why: LeaveRequestService.submit calls hasSufficientBalance; LeaveRequestService.approve calls deductBalance
LeaveRequestService.submit calls validateEntitlement to check policy rules before creating the request
